requirement: A chat session whose history holds an image with a lost stored copy still answers its next turn, instead of failing every turn as TRANSPORT

oracle.ref: PR #852 (fix); fix evidence: tasks/evidence/chat-missing-attachment/ (red and green runs on scv2, 04/10/2026)
oracle.invariant: 'turn 1 end' is {"kind":"completed"} and 'attachment objects written' is at least 1 (the image was stored and then removed). 'turn 2 end' is {"kind":"completed"}: the turn after the stored copy was removed finishes. Before the fix it was {"kind":"error","error":{"message":"DeepSeek Messages transport failed","code":"TRANSPORT"}}. 'turn 2 llm/retry events 0': no retry of the second turn (before the fix: 3 retries, all TRANSPORT). The script prints 'VERDICT: PASS' and exits 0.
oracle.productSourceGap: no deterministic run, so no code to follow; owner layer harness, needs stand, model, site:wp

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)
